scale-up.description: Extend the domain structural axis one compact-to-expanded delta beyond the expanded stratum.
scale-up.semantics_audit: reference screen plus whole-instance disjointness; no easier replacement

shifted-init.description: Use expanded-stratum arguments and a genuine fresh-seeded walk whose length equals the source problem's frozen BFS reference decisions.
shifted-init.solvability: Empirically enforced by eligibility reference screening; failures are ineligible missing coverage and are never replaced.

object-renaming.transform: Deterministic bijective rename of every task object in PDDL, text pages and scene bindings.

render-restyle.transform: Set canvas_size=160 and apply a seeded normalized layout_offset of +/-0.04 to VFG sprite bounds.

name-compression.transform: Apply a seeded bijective o0001-style object rename and remove all textual type annotations plus the complete type inventory from text-state pages.
name-compression.reference_policy: Semantic references remain valid under bijective renaming; model-side information loss is classified and reported separately.

eligibility.input_token_bound_basis: Frozen matched-v5/baseline 32768 context minus 384 output tokens.
eligibility.ineligible_policy: Report missing coverage and retain the failed profile; never replace it with an easier task.

evaluation.matching_rule: Use the fixed adapter matching each algorithm and modality.
evaluation.expansion_limit_exhaustion: A decision-call or expansion-limit exhaustion is retained as a valid unsuccessful episode, matching visual_episode result semantics.

execution_contract.resume: Persist each raw output before trusted-runtime submission; replay committed events and pending output before continuing.

throughput_probe.selection: After screening, choose the hardest eligible task in each of V1 scale-up, V2 shifted-init, P1 object-renaming, P2 render-restyle and P3 name-compression using summed reference decisions then task_id as the deterministic tie-break.
throughput_probe.generation_outputs: Mechanically discarded immediately; no episode outcome is produced or retained.
throughput_probe.precision_and_batching: Use the frozen inference contract at actual precision and batching.
throughput_probe.per_combo_bound: max(observed call time across the 3 repeated samples) × 1.5
throughput_probe.worker_overhead_probe: Measure model load and save wall time separately for every probe worker and record both values per worker.
throughput_probe.estimate: Use the frozen per-combo max-observed × 1.5 bounds without observing derived-task outcomes.

admission.episode_bound: decision_cap(task) × (max observed call time for algorithm/modality across 3 repeated samples × 1.5)
admission.worker_overhead: Measured model load wall time + measured save wall time per probe worker, added once per planned worker job.
admission.rule: (sum of decision_cap(task) × per-combo max-observed-call-time × 1.5 over the admitted matrix + measured load+save overhead per planned worker job) × 1.25 safety + probe spend already in the ledger <= branch remainder at admission time
fallback_ladder: L1 prospective documented recovery_reserve transfer to fit L0 (min sufficient, before launch)
L2 drop P3 model evaluation (generation+audit still run) => 96 tasks
L3 restrict to expanded-stratum-origin problems (S: 12x2=24, R-P1+P2: 12x2=24 => 48 tasks)
L4 VALID_STOP with partial-evidence report, no closure of unfulfilled requirements
admission.recheck: Each level is rechecked with the same admission formula.
admission.selection_timing: Execute the ladder in order before model outcomes on derived tasks.

analysis.paired_unit: whole task instance x algorithm x modality across conditions on identical tasks

primary_contrasts.source_vs_shift_degradation: Learned on derived versus learned on its source panel problem, paired by domain, stratum-origin and variant family.
primary_contrasts.learned_vs_best_control: Learned versus max of pretrained_base and per-task random_valid success frequency; exact_reference is an oracle upper bound reported separately.
primary_contrasts.validity_and_cost: Report invariant-valid success versus goal_reached, invalid-operation rate, decisions, expansions, model calls and wall time.

analysis.random_valid_aggregation: Per-task success frequency over the five frozen rollout seeds.

bootstrap.unit: whole task instance within frozen domain x family strata

analysis.tiny_subgroup_rule: Strata with fewer than 8 paired instances are descriptive-only; no interval claims.
analysis.lossy_pooling: Lossy variants are never pooled with semantics-preserving variants.
analysis.saturation_rule: Per issue #54, when the best control is at ceiling, make no structural-advantage claim.

phase1_execution: CPU-only protocol and derivation design; no real suite generation, screening, model loading or GPU execution.
